title: Application Support Engineer
description: Overview The Application Support Engineer will play a crucial role in a global Commodities Trading business, contributing to a dynamic and experienced Application Support team that serves the EU, APAC, and US regions. This position involves a variety of tasks including business as usual (BAU) support, project work, upgrades, and troubleshooting across multiple ETRM platforms, particularly during a significant migration to a new system. This role offers the opportunity to engage deeply with trading processes and technology transformations, making it ideal for individuals eager to broaden their expertise in application support within the commodities sector. Responsibilities Provide general BAU application support for ETRM systems. Lead system upgrades and new system implementation efforts. Manage project work related to ETRM integrations. Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents effectively. Collaborate with internal teams and offshore resources to support users across different regions. Understand and support trading and commodity processes to enhance system functionality. Work across multiple ETRMs, ensuring a smooth transition during migrations. Requirements Proven experience in application support roles, preferably within financial services or commodities. Familiarity with ETRM systems, with preferred experience in Endur. Strong SQL skills for data handling and querying. Solid understanding of the functional aspects of ETRMs and trading processes. Experience in both BAU and project environments. Proficiency in troubleshooting application issues. Ability to work with multiple applications and system integrations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a readiness to collaborate across offices and teams.

title: Bi/GCP Analyst
description: Overview This role as a Contract Data Engineer / BI Consultant involves supporting dashboard development and data infrastructure projects within a media agency. The contractor will collaborate closely with stakeholders to deliver high-quality reporting solutions and will focus on building and enhancing data visualization tools using Google Cloud Platform and Looker. This short-term contract position aims to fill the gap until a permanent hire joins in December. Responsibilities Build and enhance dashboards and data visualization solutions for internal and client reporting. Develop and maintain data pipelines within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery. Create and optimize Looker dashboards and reporting environments. Ensure data quality, consistency, and adherence to data governance best practices. Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver reporting solutions quickly. Support the team with ongoing data engineering and business intelligence requirements. Requirements Strong experience building dashboards and delivering data visualization solutions within a media agency environment. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery. Advanced Looker experience, including dashboard development and reporting. Good understanding of data governance principles and best practices. Ability to work independently and quickly add value in a fast-paced team. Availability for an immediate or short-notice start.

title: D365 ERP Project Manager
description: Overview The D365 ERP Project Manager will be instrumental in overseeing the transition from a legacy Microsoft Dynamics AX platform to Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management within a retail organization. This role involves close collaboration with business teams and the selected implementation partner to ensure that project milestones are met and delivered effectively. The Project Manager will engage deeply with the project details and will be responsible for driving progress, resolving issues, and maintaining alignment between stakeholders. Responsibilities Manage the delivery of the D365 Finance and Supply Chain implementation. Act as the main point of contact between the business and the implementation partner. Maintain the project plan, milestones, dependencies, and RAID log. Track delivery against the agreed requirements, scope, and budget. Coordinate business stakeholders, technical teams, and third parties. Challenge the implementation partner constructively and hold them accountable for delivery. Identify risks, remove blockers, and escalate issues where required. Support testing, data migration, business readiness, and go-live planning. Requirements Previous experience managing a Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain implementation. Experience working client-side alongside a systems integrator. Proven ownership of complex ERP implementation projects. Strong stakeholder and third-party supplier management skills. Experience supporting testing, data migration, and go-live activities. Ability to work at both programme level and in delivery detail. Pragmatic, proactive, and willing to roll up your sleeves. Desirable: Previous retail sector experience; experience migrating from Microsoft Dynamics AX to D365; understanding of finance and supply chain processes within a multi-site business.

title: Data Lead
description: Overview The Data Lead will play a crucial role in the transformation of an enterprise data platform for a large trading organization. This hands-on position focuses on guiding the development of event-streaming pipelines and production data pipelines while establishing standards for other engineers to follow. The role is primarily collaborative, working closely with teams to turn architectural designs into functional software. Responsibilities Lead the design and implementation of streaming and production data pipelines. Ensure the integration of modern lakehouse technologies into the data platform. Establish and maintain best practices and standards for data engineering. Mentor and guide engineers across various teams in technical direction. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions. Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging data technologies that enhance performance. Requirements Proven experience in building or modernising production data platforms. Strong hands-on expertise with streaming technologies, particularly Kafka or similar. Experience with lakehouse and Spark-based analytics platforms in production environments. Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation and analysis. Familiarity with public cloud services and solutions. Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.

title: Data Scientist
description: Overview In this contract role, the Data Scientist will focus on labour productivity optimisation within a large, multi-site organisation, specifically in the hospitality sector. Collaborating closely with stakeholders from Finance and Operations, the contractor will leverage their expertise in data analytics to drive measurable improvements in workforce efficiency and productivity metrics. Responsibilities Analyze labour productivity and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement. Develop and implement labour modelling and demand-led scheduling solutions. Collaborate with Finance and Operations to translate data insights into actionable strategies. Manage and interpret rota, time & attendance, and payroll data to drive efficiency. Utilize advanced SQL and BI tools to create data visualizations and reports. Support the delivery of a major workforce productivity programme across multiple sites. Requirements Minimum 5 years of analytics or data science experience in a multi-site setting, preferably within hospitality, retail, leisure, or QSR. Proven experience in labour optimisation, delivering measurable improvements in productivity metrics. Strong skills in SQL, with experience in data warehousing tools such as Snowflake or dbt. Advanced proficiency in Excel for financial modelling and understanding of P&L and labour costs. Experience with BI development tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Omni. Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders effectively and report results to finance and operations teams.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Overview This position for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer focuses on integrating agentic AI into a major UK's wealth management business while enhancing their middle-office operations. The contractor will work closely with security architecture and engineering teams to implement early controls for AI workloads and ensure secure integration practices with third-party vendors, adapting to evolving requirements. The role includes significant involvement in shaping security measures as the delivery model matures and reports directly to the security architecture team. Responsibilities Implement controls for agentic workloads, including identity management and audit trails. Engineer and test defenses against AI-related security threats. Build and operate access control systems for AI model and tool usage. Threat model AI systems based on established guidance. Provide security engineering insights for middle-office provider selection and integration. Ensure compliance with internal data handling standards and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with delivery teams to embed security practices during sprints. Develop reusable security patterns and tooling guidance for AI and integration changes. Requirements Substantial hands-on experience in security engineering within cloud environments, preferably AWS. In-depth understanding of LLM and agentic AI security risks and their mitigations. Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, API security, and token exchange. Experience conducting technical security assessments of third-party suppliers. Proven threat modeling experience on actual systems. Proficiency in Python for building and testing security measures. Familiarity with evolving requirements in a dynamic supplier landscape. Desirable knowledge of Amazon Bedrock and financial services middle office operations.

title: ERP Business Analyst
description: Overview The ERP Business Analyst will play a crucial role in the transition from a legacy Microsoft Dynamics AX platform to Dynamics 365 Finance within a retail organization. The contractor will serve as a liaison between finance stakeholders and the implementation partner, ensuring that requirements are understood and implemented effectively. This role requires engaging closely with finance teams and the Project Manager to validate processes, clarify requirements, and support testing and implementation activities. Responsibilities Act as the link between finance stakeholders and the D365 implementation partner. Validate existing requirements and ensure they are clearly understood. Map current and future-state finance processes. Translate business needs into clear functional requirements and user stories. Identify gaps, risks, and areas requiring further clarification. Support solution design workshops and challenge proposed approaches where needed. Coordinate and support UAT, including test scenarios, defect management, and sign-off. Assist with data migration, business readiness, training, and go-live activities. Requirements Strong Business Analyst experience on Dynamics 365 Finance implementations. Good understanding of core finance processes and their configuration within D365. Experience working client-side alongside a systems implementation partner. Strong process mapping, requirements validation, and documentation skills. Experience supporting UAT, defect resolution, and business sign-off. Confident working with finance teams, technical specialists, and senior stakeholders. Hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable working within a fast-moving implementation. Desirable: Previous experience within retail or another multi-site organization.

title: ERP Data Analyst
description: Overview The ERP Data Analyst will play a critical role in a retail organization's transition from a legacy ERP system to a new cloud-based platform. This contractor will collaborate with internal teams and an implementation partner to assess, prepare, and validate data for a successful migration over an initial six-week period. The position requires a hands-on approach to understand existing data, ensure its quality, and support the mapping process for the new system. Responsibilities Analyse data held within the existing ERP platform. Profile data and identify quality, consistency, and completeness issues. Support data mapping between legacy and target systems. Define and document data cleansing and transformation requirements. Work with business teams to confirm data ownership and validation rules. Liaise with the implementation partner on migration requirements and timelines. Support data extraction, cleansing, reconciliation, and validation activities. Investigate discrepancies and help resolve migration issues. Requirements Previous Data Analyst experience within an ERP implementation or migration. Strong experience in data profiling, mapping, cleansing, and validation. Good understanding of ERP data structures and migration processes. Experience reconciling data between legacy and target systems. Hands-on experience using SQL and data analysis tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Confident working with business stakeholders and implementation partners. Able to work independently and deliver within a short, focused assignment.

title: Head Of Artificial Intelligence
description: Overview The Head of Artificial Intelligence will play a critical role in leading an AI function within a dynamic energy trading organization embarking on an aggressive AI adoption strategy. This position involves defining the AI development direction, shaping the team, and remaining hands-on with technical implementations, ensuring that innovative AI solutions are effectively translated from concepts to practical applications in various business areas such as Trading, Operations, and Legal. Responsibilities Define the strategic direction for AI initiatives across the enterprise. Lead the existing AI team while mentoring and guiding future hires. Develop and demonstrate proofs of concept (POCs) that showcase potential AI applications. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and implement AI use cases that deliver real value. Ensure that AI solutions comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Integrate AI technologies with existing business systems and workflows. Oversee the development of production-grade enterprise solutions based on AI. Requirements Extensive experience in AI engineering within an enterprise setting. Strong hands-on engineering skills with practical implementation experience. Proven track record of bringing AI ideas from POCs to production. Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and autonomous AI agents. Experience in integrating AI with enterprise data and business processes. Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to senior stakeholders. Understanding of AI governance, data security, and compliance frameworks. Prior experience in the energy trading or commodities sector is highly preferred.

title: IFS Technical Consultant
description: Overview We are seeking an experienced IFS Technical Consultant specializing in Data to support a client during a crucial phase of their IFS program. This role will involve working independently with significant hands-on experience in IFS technical environments, focusing on data migration, cleansing, and management. Responsibilities Support data migration efforts within IFS environments. Perform data cleansing and validation tasks. Analyze and resolve data quality issues. Collaborate with the client to understand their data needs. Utilize SQL and PL/SQL for data extraction and transformation. Ensure adherence to IFS data structures and technical architecture. Requirements Proven experience with IFS Applications and IFS Cloud. Strong hands-on experience in data migration and cleansing. Solid understanding of IFS data structures and technical architecture. Experience handling large volumes of data. Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL. Previous involvement in IFS implementations or upgrades is essential.

title: Lead Integration Architect
description: Overview We are seeking an experienced Lead Integration Architect to join a secure public-sector data integration programme. The successful candidate will design secure integration solutions across various independent source systems while collaborating closely with engineering, security, and data teams. This position requires strong technical expertise in API architecture and a thorough understanding of data modeling, with a focus on ensuring security and resilience in data integration environments. Responsibilities Lead the overall integration architecture across multiple source systems. Design secure federated and distributed data integration solutions. Define RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specifications, and integration patterns. Design reusable integration services and source-specific adapters. Define data flows, common data models, and source-to-target mapping. Ensure consideration of security, access controls, auditability, and resilience. Produce architecture diagrams and technical design documentation. Support technical proof of concept and alpha delivery. Requirements Active SC clearance and NPPV3 are essential. Strong experience as an Integration Architect or Lead Integration Architect. Proven experience with integrating multiple heterogeneous systems. Extensive API architecture experience with REST and OpenAPI. Experience with federated or distributed data architectures. Understanding of data modeling and source-to-target mapping is crucial. Knowledge of secure data access, authentication, authorization, and auditability. Familiarity with designing for resilience in complex integration environments.

title: Mobile Architect
description: Overview The role of a Mobile Architect involves leading the architectural reconstruction of large existing mobile systems in a hybrid work environment. The contractor will work closely with stakeholders, including CTO-level executives, to define architecture characteristics, assess system quality, and ensure robust mobile-to-backend integration. They will leverage their expertise in iOS and Android technologies to guide the architectural direction of the projects, managing complexities that arise in a mixed technology landscape. Responsibilities Reconstruct architecture of large existing mobile systems using code, interviews, and artifacts. Define architecture characteristics and assess systems against them. Utilize documentation-as-code tooling and diagramming tools for clarity and collaboration. Engage with executive stakeholders to present findings and elicit valuable information. Analyze and validate integration patterns between mobile apps and backend services. Identify architectural patterns utilized in large production apps and provide actionable insights. Manage modularization at scale using relevant tools and frameworks. Produce early drafts of architectural documentation for discussion and refinement. Requirements Extensive experience in mobile architecture, particularly with iOS, Swift, UIKit, and SwiftUI. Demonstrable fluency in structured modelling approaches like C4, arc42, and UML. Hands-on knowledge of architectural patterns such as MVVM, VIPER, TCA. Familiarity with mobile-to-backend integration patterns including REST and GraphQL. Understanding of identity and authorization frameworks such as OAuth 2.0 and Open Banking concepts. Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with executive-level discussions. Ability to produce clear written documentation suitable for diverse audiences. Experience in regulated environments, preferably within a UK or EU retail bank.

title: Oracle Developer
description: Overview The Oracle Developer will initially engage in a 2-3 month contract role focused on the development and enhancement of Oracle Service Cloud solutions. This role requires a blend of technical development, system configuration expertise, and collaboration with business stakeholders to create and implement effective customer service platforms. The developer will troubleshoot issues, manage data integrity, and support integrations with third-party applications, ensuring optimal functionality and compliance with organizational practices. Responsibilities Configure and administer Oracle Service Cloud applications to meet business needs. Design, create, and maintain custom objects, fields, tables, and relationships within the platform. Develop and configure business rules, workflows, and automation processes to streamline customer service operations. Support data management activities, including data imports, exports, and integrity checks. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Troubleshoot and resolve platform, configuration, and data-related issues promptly. Support and develop integrations between Oracle Service Cloud and third-party applications. Document technical designs, configurations, and development activities for compliance and knowledge sharing. Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent commercial experience. Certifications in Oracle Service Cloud are highly desirable. Experience with SQL, database design, and integration technologies. Proven track record of configuring and developing within Oracle Service Cloud. Strong understanding of data migration, system customization, and user interface design. Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders. Experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues. Familiarity with Oracle best practices and security standards.

title: Planning Engineer
description: Overview We are seeking a Planning Engineer with expertise in offshore wind and Transportation & Installation (T&I) projects. The successful candidate will work closely with the Planning Manager and the Project Controls team to develop and maintain project schedules, ensuring alignment with contractual standards and project requirements. This role is ideal for those with significant experience in major offshore construction projects, particularly in the offshore Oil & Gas and wind sectors. Responsibilities Develop detailed project schedules in accordance with contractual requirements. Review schedule feasibility, identifying constraints and critical activities. Implement and maintain project planning and progress control systems. Monitor progress against the baseline and report any deviations. Create and manage 90-day look-ahead, weekly, and monthly schedules. Support project status and progress reporting. Collaborate with engineering, procurement, construction, and project teams to maintain schedule awareness. Assist with contract amendments and claims through time impact analysis. Requirements Strong experience as a Planning Engineer on major offshore construction projects. Proven background in Offshore Wind projects and/or Offshore Oil & Gas Installation. Experience in tendering and bid-stage planning. Familiarity with Transportation & Installation (T&I) projects. Knowledge of schedule impacts, variations, and time impact analysis. Proficient in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Relevant qualifications, such as HNC, HND, or degree in engineering or project controls.

title: Planning Manager
description: Overview As a Planning Manager for major water projects, you will be instrumental in overseeing the planning, monitoring, and control of significant capital projects. Collaborating within the programme delivery team, you will ensure that project schedules accurately reflect performance across various disciplines and stakeholders, facilitating informed decision-making and programme alignment with strategic objectives. Responsibilities Develop and maintain integrated programme schedules for complex projects. Ensure the Integrated Master Schedule aligns with objectives and contractual commitments. Identify gaps and conflicts within the programme that may affect delivery. Monitor schedule performance and escalate significant risks to stakeholders. Translate complex data into insights for business decisions and reporting. Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to resolve scheduling issues. Support governance processes and schedule quality assurance activities. Contribute to scenario planning and quantitative schedule risk analysis. Requirements Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Controls, or related discipline. Proven experience in managing programmes within water infrastructure or major civil projects. Strong track record in developing integrated schedules across multi-disciplinary teams. Familiarity with NEC and/or FIDIC contract environments. Understanding of programme management interfaces with commercial and project controls. Experience in schedule risk analysis and performance reporting. Knowledge of regulatory processes and project governance requirements. Excellent communication skills and ability to provide executive-level insights.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Overview We are seeking a skilled Platform Engineer to focus on complex infrastructure challenges within our team. This role involves building reliable systems that support large cloud deployments while enhancing operational resilience. The candidate will collaborate with client teams, implement Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and apply their strong technical expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration. Responsibilities Build and operate shared infrastructure and internal developer platforms to accelerate delivery. Improve existing systems by identifying and addressing platform gaps. Utilize modern Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane for infrastructure management. Assist client teams in developing effective habits, tooling, and practices for quality and speed. Write software to solve infrastructure issues, leveraging programming languages such as Go, Python, or Java. Requirements Deep knowledge of cloud architecture, including AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes. Proficiency in coding with languages like Go, Python, or Java. Ability to create and maintain scalable and reliable platforms. Strong understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies and tooling.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Overview We are seeking a Senior DevOps/DevSecOps Engineer to join a major UK wealth management firm in their transformation projects involving agentic AI and middle-office operations. This role will focus on implementing security controls for AI workloads and integrating security measures into the new middle-office platform while collaborating with various teams to ensure that security considerations are integrated into the development process. The engineer will work closely with security architecture and engineering teams and will have the opportunity to shape security protocols as the new provider and delivery model are developed. Responsibilities Implement security controls for agentic workloads, including OAuth token exchanges and least-privilege policies. Engineer defenses against various AI-related security vulnerabilities. Design and operate access controls for AI model usage and enforce data-residency standards. Conduct threat modeling for AI systems and translate insights into actionable backlog items. Provide security engineering support during middle-office provider selection and integration. Ensure compliance with internal data handling standards and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with delivery teams to integrate security practices into their workflows. Produce reusable security patterns and tooling guidance for adoption in development. Requirements Significant hands-on experience in security engineering, preferably in AWS environments. Proficient understanding of LLM and agentic AI security risks and relevant controls. Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, and API security. Experienced in conducting technical assessments of third-party suppliers. Demonstrated ability in threat modeling on actual systems. Proficient in Python or similar languages for implementing security measures. Comfortable navigating evolving requirements within the supplier ecosystem. Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and relevant compliance frameworks is advantageous.

title: Project Manager
description: Overview The Project Manager will oversee multiple power infrastructure projects across North Scotland, focusing on underground cabling, civils, and distribution substation works. Working in a hybrid arrangement, they will collaborate with project teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and meet contractual requirements, while directly responding to the increased workload and growth in the contractor’s operations. Responsibilities Manage multiple power infrastructure projects across the North of Scotland. Take responsibility for projects throughout the construction and delivery lifecycle. Manage civils and underground cable packages across distribution infrastructure projects. Oversee programme, resource, contractor, and project delivery requirements. Coordinate activities across project teams, subcontractors, clients, and other stakeholders. Ensure projects are delivered safely and efficiently in accordance with programme and contractual requirements. Provide project leadership across site delivery while maintaining visibility across programme and project risks. Requirements Strong Project Management experience within the UK Transmission & Distribution sector. Previous experience working for a Tier 1 power infrastructure or utilities contractor is highly desirable. Strong experience delivering underground cable and associated civils packages. Experience delivering projects for SSEN is particularly relevant. Candidates with a civils or electrical background will be considered, although strong civils knowledge is preferred.

title: Project Manager
description: Overview We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join a dynamic team in the automotive manufacturing sector. The successful candidate will oversee new product introduction (NPI) projects, managing them from initiation to delivery while coordinating with various stakeholders. This long-term contract position offers a competitive rate and the opportunity to work on a strong pipeline of projects. Responsibilities Manage automotive manufacturing projects from initial stages through to delivery. Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure project alignment and success. Oversee new product introduction (NPI) initiatives and related activities. Ensure that project milestones and timelines are met. Implement best practices and maintain project documentation. Facilitate communication within the project team and across departments. Adapt to project requirements and address challenges as they arise. Requirements Proven experience in project management within the automotive manufacturing sector. Strong background in new product introduction (NPI) processes. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent communication and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and hit the ground running.

title: QA Engineer
description: Overview We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer with a focus on Automation and API Testing to join a dynamic remote team. This role involves designing and maintaining robust automation frameworks to enhance software quality and support reliable delivery processes. As a pivotal member of the QA team, you will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the stability and security of software releases. Responsibilities Design and evolve automation strategies for API, UI, contract, and component testing. Develop and maintain automation frameworks and scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Investigate flaky tests and identify root causes to enhance test stability. Troubleshoot complex automation failures and recommend corrective actions. Provide detailed reports that highlight significant risks to inform decision-making. Review automation code and mentor junior engineers to uphold coding standards. Create reusable components and libraries to improve automation efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure trustworthy software releases. Requirements Proven experience in designing and maintaining automation frameworks with a strong emphasis on API testing. Proficiency in programming languages such as Java and Python. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipeline integration for automated tests. Solid understanding of SDLC/STLC and Agile methodologies. Ability to critically review automation code and promote best practices. Familiarity with compliance and security standards in healthcare data systems is a plus.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Overview We are seeking a skilled Quality Assurance Engineer to join a dedicated engineering team focused on a significant transformation programme. The contractor will work remotely from anywhere in the UK, contributing to building a quality-first engineering culture and ensuring the delivery of reliable software through testing. This role involves collaborating with developers and other stakeholders to advance quality assurance processes and best practices in a modern SaaS environment. Responsibilities Drive quality across products and features from planning through to release. Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies. Build and maintain automated test frameworks for web applications and APIs. Perform functional, regression, performance, stress, and accessibility testing. Work closely with developers to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. Identify risks early and ensure high-quality software is delivered at pace. Support the evolution of QA processes, standards, and best practices. Measure quality through meaningful metrics and continuous improvement initiatives. Requirements Strong commercial experience in Software Quality Assurance and Test Engineering. Experience testing modern web applications and REST APIs. Hands-on experience with test planning, design, execution, and automation. Experience with performance, stress, and regression testing. Knowledge of industry-standard test automation frameworks and tools. Experience with both black-box and white-box testing. Understanding of accessibility testing and security testing practices. Experience using Azure DevOps, including Test Plans.

title: RAID Lead / Programme Planner
description: Overview The RAID Lead and Programme Planner roles focus on managing critical aspects of a significant multi-Trust digital transformation programme within the NHS. The successful candidates will work primarily in a remote capacity while collaborating with diverse workstreams and senior stakeholders to ensure effective governance, risk management, and integrated planning. These positions are intended for experienced professionals who can bring substantial programme controls expertise to a complex transformation effort. Responsibilities Take ownership of programme-level risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies. Drive ownership, mitigation, escalation, and effective governance across multiple workstreams. Produce comprehensive programme-level RAID reporting and analysis. Develop and manage the integrated programme plan, consolidating multiple workstream plans. Identify and challenge planning assumptions and schedule risks. Work closely with senior programme stakeholders to ensure alignment and resolve issues. Maintain awareness of project milestones, dependencies, and critical paths. Requirements Significant experience in managing RAID across complex transformation programmes. Strong risk, issue, and dependency management expertise. Proven ability to develop and manage integrated programme plans. Excellent understanding of programme governance and controls. Experience in producing detailed programme-level reports and analytics. Confidence in challenging and influencing workstream plans. Background in large-scale integrated digital transformation programmes, preferably with NHS exposure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Overview The Senior Data Engineer will join a dynamic team focused on modernizing the data architecture within a well-established transport and travel sector organization. This role involves designing and building high-quality data pipelines and contributing to the broader data transformation efforts by leveraging Databricks and Spark technologies. Collaborating closely with various stakeholders, the contractor will play a crucial role in shaping the technical direction of the data platform while ensuring data integrity and security throughout the project lifecycle. Responsibilities Design and implement high-quality end-to-end data pipelines. Lead data modeling initiatives in collaboration with business analysts and engineering teams. Manage projects across the full lifecycle from planning to delivery and operational run. Maintain a strong focus on security and data protection throughout development processes. Requirements A minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in data engineering. Strong expertise in Databricks and Spark, including performance optimization and use of Delta Lake. Proficient in Python with a solid understanding of software development and DevOps practices. Excellent data modeling skills, demonstrating the ability to navigate technical and organizational trade-offs. Advanced SQL skills with experience in querying data lakes or lakehouses. Experience in data ingestion through APIs or database connections. Familiarity with Agile methodologies in a self-organizing team environment.

title: Senior Java Engineer
description: Overview The Senior Java Engineer will play a pivotal role in developing complex software solutions within the financial services and energy trading sectors. This position requires hands-on involvement in both greenfield and brownfield development projects and entails collaborating with experienced engineering teams to tackle technical challenges. The engineer will also engage with emerging technologies such as digital assets and blockchain in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Responsibilities Develop and enhance server-side Java/JVM applications, focusing on robust back-end solutions. Build services using Spring and Spring Boot for various projects. Engage in both greenfield and brownfield development within trading and post-trade workflows. Create solutions that support settlement processes, particularly within equities. Utilize Kubernetes and event-driven architecture on cloud and on-premise infrastructures. Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to gather intricate requirements and deliver tailored solutions. Own technical challenges from initial investigation through to implementation and delivery. Adapt to ambiguity and changing requirements in a fast-moving environment. Requirements 5–10+ years of commercial software development experience in a hands-on role. Strong server-side Java/JVM development expertise. Extensive experience with Spring and Spring Boot frameworks. Background in complex greenfield and/or brownfield systems. Proficient with Linux operating systems. Experience in financial services, trading, or energy trading sectors. Comfortable with problem-solving in ambiguous environments. Polyglot development experience is beneficial, but strong Java skills are essential.

title: Senior Java/Aeron Engineers
description: Overview We are looking for experienced Senior Java Engineers to join an engineering team focused on the design and development of high-performance, low-latency systems using Java and Aeron. This role involves collaborating with a team of skilled engineers to tackle complex technical challenges and contribute to mission-critical software development. The position offers opportunities for professional growth while delivering scalable, event-driven solutions in a dynamic work environment. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java applications. Build and optimise low-latency, high-throughput systems using Aeron. Work with Aeron Media Driver, Aeron Cluster, and related messaging technologies. Analyse and optimise application performance, latency, memory usage, and garbage collection. Develop efficient concurrent and multithreaded software. Collaborate with architects, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver robust solutions. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. Troubleshoot complex production issues and support continuous system improvements. Requirements Strong commercial experience developing software in Java. Proven experience working with Aeron or comparable high-performance messaging technologies. Solid understanding of low-latency software development and performance optimisation. Strong knowledge of Java concurrency, multithreading, and JVM performance tuning. Experience with garbage collection, memory management, and efficient data structures. Understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Experience with profiling, benchmarking, and performance analysis tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Overview The Service Delivery Manager will oversee the delivery of IT services within a Contact Centre Support Team, ensuring compliance with SLAs and managing client expectations in a dynamic environment. This contract position involves collaborating closely with customers and internal teams to enhance service delivery while driving service improvement initiatives based on performance metrics and customer feedback. The role is suited for individuals with a strong technical background in IT service management and experience in managing service teams. Responsibilities Oversee end-to-end delivery of IT services across infrastructure and support functions. Ensure services are delivered in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs and compliance requirements. Monitor service performance metrics, analyze trends, and generate detailed reports. Act as the main point of contact for the customer on service delivery and performance. Manage incident, problem and change management processes following ITIL best practices. Coordinate with internal infrastructure, development and support teams to resolve issues. Drive service improvement initiatives based on performance data and customer feedback. Manage vendor relationships and third-party service providers. Requirements Active DV Clearance as a UK Sole National. Strong experience in IT service delivery and operations. Familiarity with IT service management frameworks and ITIL v3 or v4 certification preferred. Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or CA Service Desk. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills. Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities under pressure. Experience managing cross-functional teams in a complex technical environment. Background in application hosting or infrastructure components related to IT service delivery.

title: Software Developer
description: Overview We are seeking a Software Developer to facilitate the migration of integrations between two systems using Microsoft Fabric pipelines. This role focuses on implementing scalable and high-performance integrations, while collaborating with users to ensure effective system integration. The developer will also maintain updated knowledge of IT developments and contribute to user documentation and training materials. Responsibilities Implement scalable and high-quality integrations through systems analysis and programming. Collaborate with users to ensure effective integration of systems using established standards. Maintain knowledge of IT developments and software analysis, design, and programming tools. Assist in creating user documentation and training materials as necessary. Deploy integrations and provide user training for information systems. Requirements Proven experience using Microsoft Fabric to orchestrate workflows. Practical knowledge of Azure platform development, particularly Azure Integration Services (AIS).
